statements.subject: server
statements.description: A UAS that receives a second INVITE before it sends the final response to a first INVITE with a lower CSeq sequence number on the same dialog MUST return a 500 (Server Internal Error) response to the second INVITE and MUST include a Retry-After header field with a randomly chosen value of between 0 and 10 seconds.
statements.trigger: second INVITE received before final response to first INVITE sent on same dialog
statements.pre_cond: uas.first_invite.final_response_sent = false & uas.first_invite.CSeq < uas.second_invite.CSeq & uas.dialog.same = true
actions: return 500 (Server Internal Error) response to the second INVITE

statements.subject: server
statements.description: A UAS that receives a second INVITE before it sends the final response to a first INVITE with a lower CSeq sequence number on the same dialog MUST return a 500 (Server Internal Error) response to the second INVITE and MUST include a Retry-After header field with a randomly chosen value of between 0 and 10 seconds.
statements.trigger: second INVITE received before final response to first INVITE sent on same dialog
statements.pre_cond: uas.first_invite.final_response_sent = false & uas.first_invite.CSeq < uas.second_invite.CSeq & uas.dialog.same = true
actions: include Retry-After header field with a randomly chosen value of between 0 and 10 seconds in the 500 response

statements.subject: server
statements.description: A UAS that receives an INVITE on a dialog while an INVITE it had sent on that dialog is in progress MUST return a 491 (Request Pending) response to the received INVITE.
statements.trigger: INVITE received on dialog while UAS-sent INVITE on same dialog is in progress
actions: return 491 (Request Pending) response to the received INVITE

statements.subject: participant
statements.description: If a UA receives a re-INVITE for an existing dialog, it MUST check any version identifiers in the session description or, if there are no version identifiers, the content of the session description to see if it has changed.
actions: check version identifiers in the session description
if no version identifiers exist, check content of session description to see if it has changed

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the session description has changed, the UAS MUST adjust the session parameters accordingly, possibly after asking the user for confirmation.
actions: optionally ask user for confirmation before adjusting

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the new session description is not acceptable, the UAS can reject it by returning a 488 (Not Acceptable Here) response for the re-INVITE.  This response SHOULD include a Warning header field.
actions: include a Warning header field in the 488 response

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If a UAS generates a 2xx response and never receives an ACK, it SHOULD generate a BYE to terminate the dialog.
statements.trigger: ACK not received after 2xx response sent
actions: generate a BYE to terminate the dialog

statements.subject: server
statements.description: A UAS MAY choose not to generate 180 (Ringing) responses for a re-INVITE because UACs do not typically render this information to the user.
actions: optionally omit 180 (Ringing) provisional response for re-INVITE

statements.subject: server
statements.description: For the same reason, UASs MAY choose not to use an Alert-Info header field or a body with Content-Disposition "alert" in responses to a re-INVITE.
actions: optionally omit Alert-Info header field in responses to re-INVITE
optionally omit body with Content-Disposition alert in responses to re-INVITE

statements.subject: server
statements.description: A UAS providing an offer in a 2xx (because the INVITE did not contain an offer) SHOULD construct the offer as if the UAS were making a brand new call, subject to the constraints of sending an offer that updates an existing session, as described in [13] in the case of SDP.
statements.trigger: UAS generating offer in 2xx response to INVITE without offer
actions: construct offer as if making a brand new call, subject to constraints of updating an existing session

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Specifically, this means that it SHOULD include as many media formats and media types that the UA is willing to support.
statements.trigger: UAS constructing offer in 2xx response to INVITE without offer
actions: include as many media formats and media types that the UA is willing to support in the offer

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The UAS MUST ensure that the session description overlaps with its previous session description in media formats, transports, or other parameters that require support from the peer.
statements.trigger: UAS constructing offer in 2xx response to INVITE without offer
actions: ensure new session description overlaps with previous session description in media formats, transports, or other parameters requiring peer support

statements.subject: client
statements.description: If, however, it is unacceptable to the UAC, the UAC SHOULD generate an answer with a valid session description, and then send a BYE to terminate the session.
statements.trigger: UAS offer in 2xx is unacceptable to UAC
actions: generate an answer with a valid session description
send a BYE to terminate the session
